mapper.select: SELECT st.*, e.name AS exam_name, es.subject_name, c.class_name AS class_name FROM score_statistics st LEFT JOIN exam e ON e.id = st.exam_id LEFT JOIN exam_subject es ON es.id = st.exam_subject_id LEFT JOIN class_info c ON c.id = st.class_id WHERE st.exam_id = #{examId} ORDER BY st.stat_type, c.class_name, es.sort

SELECT st.*, e.name AS exam_name, es.subject_name, c.class_name AS class_name FROM score_statistics st LEFT JOIN exam e ON e.id = st.exam_id LEFT JOIN exam_subject es ON es.id = st.exam_subject_id LEFT JOIN class_info c ON c.id = st.class_id WHERE st.exam_subject_id = #{examSubjectId} AND st.stat_type = 1 ORDER BY c.class_name
